text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: All done—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day during the camp, Transcend's 
triumphant shout echoed through the air.
choice_data_list: Tran, what do you mean "it's done"?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's a gadget, a gadget. Come on, I told 
you about it before.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"That thing you said we totally needed if 
we wanna keep winning from here on out."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. Wanna see? Wanna see? Hey, you 
wanna see, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What kind of tool could it possibly be? A 
special workout machine, or perhaps 
something for recovery?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well then, making its world premiere! What 
I've been developing this whole time 
is—this!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Cinema Gun"!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yep. Don't go thinking this is just an 
ordinary camcorder, though. This "Cinema 
Gun" is...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, it'd probably be easier to see 
just how amazing this kid is by seeing it 
in action.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
For example, if I snap a picture of Trainy 
like this—...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Beep, beep, beep, bee-bee-bee-beep!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I see. Upper arm strength 12.53, abdominal 
strength 16.24, upper body coordination 
rate 32.4%, with a latent value of 12.2%.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"And just like that, it analyzes the 
target's abilities in detail, quantifies 
them, and compiles them into a database."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
In other words, we can make our very own 
ultra-precise Umamusume encyclopedia.
choice_data_list:
Super high precision, huh. That's 
incredible...

Super high precision, huh. That's 
amazing...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I track data from every race, 
but to have our latent potential analyzed 
as well... the value is immeasurable.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Let's see now. Since we're here, I'd like 
to learn a bit more about you, 
Train-chan...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Running Power: 5... Heh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking photos of myself wouldn't reveal 
its true value. I decided to try taking 
photos of other Umamusume as a test.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Rickeyâ Luckyâ Super Happy!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Tarumae. Do you think we'll be 
able to debut someday too? According to 
feng shui...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Geez... Rickey... Training should come 
before feng shui.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Oh, spotted the perfect subject.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The Feng Shui Umamusume, Copano Rickey, 
and Tomakomai's local idol, Hokko Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Their debuts are still far off, but let's 
take a look at their abilities.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I filmed and took measurements. And the 
result was—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: H-Huh? What are these readings...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey has an expected value of 
11,000, and Hokko Tarumae has an expected 
value of 10,000...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
This is way too high, no matter how you 
slice it... Is this thing broken or what?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Cinemagun doesn't seem to be working 
properly. It looks like it still needs 
more adjustments.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainy. Looks like I still need to 
do some practice shoots to get used to it. 
So, can you help me out?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead and snap as many pics of me as 
you want. I wanna know if all the 
different stats show up accurately.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with Transcend as our model, we 
decided to shoot all sorts of videos.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa. When you're shooting at the 
beach, gravure poses are practically a 
given, right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trai-chan, how's it looking? Am I giving 
off over 9000 Summer Umamusume energy?
choice_data_list: No, it says not to push yourself...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... You saw right through my forced 
motivation... Maybe it really did kick 
into gear once I started moving, though.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Then next, instead of gravure shots, let's 
take different measurements. So we can 
gauge even more data.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'll leave the theme to you, Trainy. It's 
a short film starring yours truly. What 
kind of movie do ya wanna shoot?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What kind of movie should we film starring 
Transcend? The idea that came to mind 
was...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"A gritty crime action flick, huh? Sounds 
great. In movies, you can do all the bad 
stuff you want."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Let's show 'em just how scary a broker of 
dark information can be! Alright then, 
rolling camera!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Damn it, what a mess! How are we supposed 
to airlift this loot out by helicopter 
now...?!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I have to carry this all the way to the 
mountaintop!"
choice_data_list: Alright, action! Let the climb begin!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trai-chan... are you a demon~? Is this 
what they call cruel and unusual 
punishment?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, nothing can be done. Let's take the 
mountain path one step at a time, then...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... I'm dead, for real... My 
legs are so swollen...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look, Trainer! My muscle strength stat 
went up! It really reflected my effort!
choice_data_list: Good. Looks like it's working properly.
Good! Looks like it's working properly!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, all that's left is to gather data. 
By facing my dirt rivals head-on in real 
races.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Let's hack everyone's running, and go! One 
day, beyond the realm of imagination!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, the ultimate gadget was complete. 
From here on out, Transcend will forge 
ahead with even greater strength."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"A slow-burn romance... for me...? Would 
there even be a demand for that?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I thought I was stuck in the 'friend 
forever' zone. Oh well! Alright, let's 
start rolling!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Hey. We've been hanging out for over ten 
years now, ever since kindergarten, 
right?"
choice_data_list:
Still, I don't know how they feel about 
it...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Is there something you don't get~? At this 
stage in the game? Hmm, this is...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Then allow me to make you understand. 
There!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Did you get that?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Gah...! What is with this fortress of 
dense obliviousness...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Why you little...! Take this, love! Love 
love loooove! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, I tried recording it, but it's just 
so embarrassing after all~. I'm not used 
to saying lines like that anyway~."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look, Trainer! My patience stat went 
up! Because I endured through the 
frustration!
choice_data_list: Good. Looks like it's working properly.
Good! Looks like it's working properly!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, all that's left is to gather data. 
By facing my dirt rivals head-on in real 
races.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Let's hack everyone's running, and go! One 
day, beyond the realm of imagination!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, the ultimate gadget was complete. 
Transcend will continue to persevere down 
the long road ahead."
